title: Microsoft Flight Simulator PC Update ✅ 8LEGS Polynesia Grand Tour & VA Airline Ops Added!
description:
MSFS Marketplace Update (March 28, 2026): Exploring the best MSFS activities and Microsoft Flight Simulator missions released this week for PC! The highlight of this MSFS 2020 Marketplace Update is the stunning 8LEGS GRAND TOUR – POLYNESIA by Perfect Flight, offering an incredible multi-leg island hopping adventure.

We also dive into new MSFS realistic operations with the latest VA SYSTEMS Airline Schedules (Winter 2025) and sightseeing missions like Koschi’s All the Sights of Japan. If you want to expand your Microsoft Flight Simulator addons collection with fresh gameplay, this weekly PC update has everything you need.

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: 8LEGS GRAND TOUR – POLYNESIA (Multi‑leg scenic island‑hopping adventure)
🗺️ Koschi: All the sights of Japan (Sightseeing missions across Japan’s iconic landmarks)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airline scheduled - ANG [Winter 2025] (Realistic airline schedule operations)

If you enjoyed this week’s new missions and airline schedule activities, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe for weekly MSFS Marketplace Updates, and drop a comment below with which activity you’ll be flying first!

Thanks for watching this week’s update and happy flying ✈️ See you in the skies!
